_schema_note: Maps `matrices:` slugs from source-page frontmatter to `products:` slugs (the routing target). Used by tools/autonomy/reverse-route-products.mjs. Each key is a matrix slug as it appears in source frontmatter (lowercase, hyphenated). Each value is an object with `products` (list of product page slugs to add to source `products:`) and `confidence` (high|medium — high means apply automatically, medium means surface for review). A matrix slug absent from this map is logged to matrix-mapping-unmapped.csv for review. Broad-scope tokens (infant-formula, baby-cereals, etc.) are valid product values; the routing audit's inheritedProductRoutes map fans them out to row pages.
_no_route_note: Biological matrices (blood, urine, hair, breast-milk, fish-muscle), environmental matrices (soil, water, sediment), and methodological terms (analytical-method, dietary-intake, dry-weight) live in `_no_route` below. The script silently skips them.
